items.headline: Virginia bounces back, takes care of business against Delaware with 42-3 win
items.description: — Quarterback Beau Pribula scored five touchdowns, helping Virginia jump out to a two-score lead on its way to a 42-3 win over Delaware on Saturday night at Scott Stadium.

items.headline: Virginia hosts Delaware in Week 4
items.description: Delaware (2-1) at Virginia (2-1), Sept. 26 at 6 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Kentucky's jab after Texas A&M upset leads top trolls of CFB Week 3
items.description: After an upset win, Kentucky made sure to needle Texas A&M virtually for good measure.

items.headline: Nick Minicucci connects with Sean Wilson for 185 yards, 2 TDs as Delaware beats CCU 22-14
items.description: — Nick Minicucci threw for 302 yards and two touchdowns, with 185 yards and two scores going to Sean Wilson, and Delaware beat Coastal Carolina 22-14 on Saturday in the first meeting between the programs.
